name: updates-changed
title: UpdatesChanged after an apt hook
description: apt installed libsoup-3.0-common outside PackageKit and its 20packagekit hook calls StateHasChanged("cache-update"); the fake broadcasts UpdatesChanged (and, as if packagekit itself had been updated, RestartSchedule), which every connection (client and observer) receives. GW2b (review m2): the list then has 1 update left.
